rescue.table-redefined: Table `{Table}` is already defined. In this layout a table is named by its sheet tab, less any trailing `Table`, so two tabs whose names agree once that word is dropped collide.
rescue.enum-label-redefined: Label '{Label}' is already defined in enum '{Enum}'.
rescue.column-name-clash: Table `{Table}` has two columns called `{Field}`: it uses {How}. Names are normalized so that every language gets the same member out of them, and two columns cannot share one. Rename one of them, or put a `#` on the description of the column that is no longer used. (the other is at {Other})
rescue.enum-name-must-follow-marker: In case of enum type, the enum name must follow `enum:`.
rescue.enum-not-declared: Column `{Field}` is typed `{Declared}`, but no enum named `{Enum}` was declared. Enums come from the sheet whose name contains `{Marker}`.
rescue.type-not-array-element: type `{Type}` cannot be used as an array element.
